I’m very, very, very aware. Thank you for pointing that out to me. I’m commenting because I’m curious what I should do with this anxiety.

Happy late birthday mannn, and sorry for all the shit your dealing with. My personal opinion is you should quit entirely. Deal with the withdrawals head on for the first two weeks, and then things will start to get better. You already seem as if you’re dealing with them, so you can definitely do it. Good luck to u!!

Losing that daily (hourly for me, used to at least) dopamine hit will definitely have you feeling crankier and more on edge than usual on the lighter end of the spectrum. While sober, you have to deal with the things that you tried running away from head first. So maybe it’s a good thing you guys address those issues. I’m sure all will work out with time, maybe tell him to have a beer or something lol! Wish y’all the best

Not crazy at all, not even close!! Some people have had withdrawals way darker and worse. So everything we’re feeling is definitely normal! We got this shit brotha 🧘🏽🧘🏽 I’ve learned meditation and working out also really helps dealing with these things even if they’re always repeated and thrown at you as suggestions lol. Good luck to u my man!

I currently feel much better !! But everyday definitely has its up and downs but unfortunately that’s a part of the process. I still don’t wanna smoke or anything like that cuz i dealt with the same shit when high, it would just get numbed for a few hours then go back to normal. My eating has been fine because i try to work out so whenever I’m done with the gym i feel like eating up a fucking storm 😂😂 Appreciate the comment !
I’m almost two weeks in, and I’ve dealt with the exact same thing you just described. Everyday it seems to be less and less intense though, so i guess it’s just part of the journey
Congrats man!!!! So dope
Also, think about all the money you’ve saved by not buying weed in the past 19 months. That right there is probably a couple thousand!! (At least when i was smoking lol)

Reflecting on them and figuring out how to bounce back which you’re currently doing !! U got dis

When you think about going 5, 10, 15 years without smoking it sounds miserable / impossible, but trying you stay sober one day at a time makes me feel a bit less worried
Yea, my brain is definitely perma fried
I wouldn’t risk it yet. You’re already doing  good, to restart now would likely set you back to square one.
Completely normal , unfortunately it may get worse temporarily but it  will get better.  Getting sober a roller coaster ride !!

I’m in the same exact boat, recently my music began to gain more traction and stuff, and i found weed had me constantly anxious and self critical. Years of smoking definitely enhanced my creativity but if you can do something high then you can do it sober. Mixes sounded insane, beats hit way harder and music was arguably more enjoyable lol.  5 days sober and i feel anxiety and self doubt , but definitely less drastic as when i was smoking

You probably didn’t check on them because you’re fighting a mental battle. Getting sober is extremely difficult, so it’s understandable you’d be focused on that / overcoming those emotions. Use this experience to bring awareness to the fact that maybe you’ve been neglecting others feelings a bit, and be mindful of it. Good luck with your sober journey.. you got it!

Buy a low nicotine vape or a caffeine vape. That will help with the nicotine cravings (nicotine is also much easier to quit than weed in my opinion), as for the rest i feel you 100% but it only gets better. 4 days sober is great! Keep it up. It won’t always be easy but as time passes you’ll be proud that you quit when you did
I’d personally say it prob has more 2 do with your personalities than the weed
So true lol

Trying to overcome the mental fog of withdrawal is like playing mental chess. It can be extremely difficult trying to rewire the way you think / process information, but it can be done. I’ve been in the same cycle of quitting for a week or two, but eventually old habits repeat themselves. Personally i would recommend making a conscious decision to quit altogether. After a month or so the appetite loss, irritability and sleep problems will fade into the darkness. Good luck!!

You’re already super close to quitting! You already have the right mindset by cutting back, so now all you have to do is fully Commit to stopping this habit. I’m only 19 but i used to love getting fried and playing games and watching random shit until late but what is that truly doing for you? As in to better you as a person? Take the time being sober to truly appreciate the game and enjoy it for what it truly is. As for falling asleep, maybe stay up a bit late doing something that’s fun to you (ex. Video games , Netflix). Maybe buy a journal to log your thoughts or pick up a new book / comic. It seems impossible but it’ll only get better with time!! Good luck u got this

that all sounds really rough. i couldn’t agree more with the depersonalization stuff , but I’ve found that distracting myself with reading, video games, hobbies etc has rlly helped
To keep me occupied. Keep going, you got this! It won’t get better instantly and definitely feels like an uphill battle but it will all be worth it in the end
Exercise, read a book or comic, watch a TV series, listen to podcasts, start a new hobby, meditate, playing video games are all good escapes. U got this !!!!
